subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The teacher pulled a book ________ the cupboard.
solution:
The correct answer is '**out of**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **"out of"** is used to indicate movement from the inside of a place or object to the outside.
 
• In the given sentence, the teacher is retrieving a book from inside the cupboard, making **"out of"** the correct preposition.</sp
